title: Isidore Fritz and other musicians across the lake
summary: Discussion of George's family and of Isidore Fritz, a clarinetist like Big Eye Louie who sat in with Buddy; Tommy Ladner and Bunk are mentioned.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Do you remember anything about his father? No, I don't know.
No. Or his wife? No, no.
She's still living up, you know, around Vesaline.
Yeah, Vesaline and, yeah, yeah, yeah, I heard that.
Um, she told me about that playing over there, and she didn't remember, you know, who she even enjoyed playing with.
Do you remember any of those other musicians over there in Manaville, like the Fritz brothers?
Yeah, I know the Fritz brothers, he was the Kranich player, you know what I mean? Fritz.
Isidore Fritz, that's right, he was.

Well, he was a pretty nice Kranich player, he was nice. Well, he, lots of times he'd come sit on in with Buddy's band, you know, with two Kranichs, you know what I mean? Just to get the swing of the music, you know? So after he got the swing, lots of times that Edmund Hall didn't feel like working, so he'd tell him to go in and make them jobs, you know? So he made a couple of jobs with Buddy, but he was a nice fellow.
Can you tell me anything about what he played like, or who he sounded like?
Well, you didn't know Big Eye Louie, I know you don't. No, that's right. Yeah, well he's on the order of Big Eye Louie. What he? Yeah, he's something like Big Eye Louie.

Sort of more classical kind of thing. That's right, that's right. That's right. Mm-hmm. Can you remember any of those other musicians over there, like they had Tommy Ladner there, I believe? Remember him? All right.
No, I didn't know Tommy Ladner.
He went up to New York, for sure. And then they had Bunkers over there sometimes, teaching some of those people.

Well, I weren't there when Bunker, when Bunkers over there. See, it's like I told you I came over here and I stayed over here. I didn't care about coming back because I was waiting with too many bands, you know? Yeah. And I was making more money here than I would go just waiting with one band over there, you know?
